However, significant authenticity defects exist: (1) Structural fusion in background guitars—the middle black guitar merges into the white Stratocaster behind it with indistinct boundaries and warped neck geometry; (2) Text gibberish on the foreground guitar headstock ('bnd Gmo' instead of legible branding); (3) Minor texture anomaly in cat's pink fur which appears uniformly airbrushed without natural dye variation. These artifacts prevent a perfect authenticity score but do not dominate the overall assessment given the high fidelity of primary subjects.
